name: Crystal Forge
tagline: Decides when a lattice simulation needs quantum computing and spends scarce measurements where they matter.
problem: Quantum measurements are scarce and expensive.
solution: Routes simulations between classical and quantum, and allocates measurements to the observables most relevant to superconductivity.
demo_moment: Team-described: run a lattice problem and see the routing decision.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Computational Quantum Track Hack” among 223 submissions.

lessons: Allocation is a strong angle on scarce compute.
